sqlMap.select: SELECT CITY_ID AS cityID, NAME AS name, PLAYER_ID AS playerID, (SELECT NAME FROM T_PLAYER WHERE T_PLAYER.PLAYER_ID=T_CITY.PLAYER_ID) AS playerName, (SELECT GUILD_ID FROM T_PLAYER WHERE T_PLAYER.PLAYER_ID=T_CITY.PLAYER_ID) AS guildID, (SELECT NAME FROM T_GUILD WHERE T_GUILD.GUILD_ID=guildID) AS guildName, CONSTRUCTION_POINT AS constructionPoint, TECHNOLOGY_POINT AS technologyPoint, POPULATION_TOTAL AS populationTotal FROM T_CITY WHERE CITY_ID=#cityID#
SELECT RANK FROM T_CITY_RANK WHERE TYPE=1 AND CITY_ID=#cityID#
SELECT RANK AS rank, CITY_ID AS cityID FROM T_CITY_RANK WHERE TYPE=1 LIMIT #start#, #offset#
SELECT RANK FROM T_CITY_RANK WHERE TYPE=2 AND CITY_ID=#cityID#
SELECT RANK AS rank, CITY_ID AS cityID FROM T_CITY_RANK WHERE TYPE=2 LIMIT #start#, #offset#
SELECT RANK FROM T_CITY_RANK WHERE TYPE=3 AND CITY_ID=#cityID#
SELECT RANK AS rank, CITY_ID AS cityID FROM T_CITY_RANK WHERE TYPE=3 LIMIT #start#, #offset#
